The '''Temple Valley''' was a valley that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Endregaad]]. It contained a number of rock formations, as well as various pre-fabricated units and decommissioned vehicles, that were abandoned by geode [[Mining/Legends|miners]] that were active in the area. Following a [[Endregaad Plague|viral outbreak]] on Endregaad in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], the world's inhabitants blamed the disease on [[Alien/Legends|non-Humans]] and, to evade their wrath, the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Mika Anjiliac Chiera]] and his entourage of [[Nikto/Legends|Niktos]] took shelter at an encampment in the Temple Valley, next to the remains of a crashed [[YV-100 light freighter]].
